name: Loews Corporation
description: Loews is a holding company, not an insurer in its own right: it owns about 92 percent of CNA Financial (commercial property and casualty insurance, 81 percent of revenue), all of Boardwalk Pipelines (natural gas and liquids pipelines and storage) and Loews Hotels (27 hotels), and 53 percent of Altium Packaging (plastic packaging, accounted for under the equity method, not consolidated). Because CNA dominates revenue, the Multi-line Insurance label fits the consolidated numbers, but about 30 percent of net income came from the pipeline, hotel and corporate pieces in 2025 (Boardwalk alone $444M of $1,667M).

gics.note: Conventional label per Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01), which gives only the sector and the sub-industry; GICS industry group and industry are not shown there so are left null. Mowgli classification is not set here.

employees.note: Including consolidated subsidiaries; CNA about 6,600; Boardwalk Pipelines about 1,300 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: CNA Financial (about 92% owned)
businessLines.how: Policyholders pay premiums; CNA earns underwriting profit plus investment income on the premiums it holds until claims are paid (revenue composition not extracted from the sections read).
businessLines.description: Commercial property and casualty insurance (the 10-K calls the industry highly competitive on rate and service).

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $1,211M; net income attributable to Loews $1,173M (FY2024 $879M, which carried a $265M pension settlement charge)

businessLines.name: Boardwalk Pipelines (100% owned)
businessLines.how: Customers pay for transporting and storing gas and liquids; 2025 transportation revenue rose $104M mainly from re-contracting at higher rates (10-K).
businessLines.description: Interstate pipelines for transportation and storage of natural gas, natural gas liquids and other hydrocarbons.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $505M; net income attributable to Loews $444M (FY2024 $413M)

businessLines.name: Loews Hotels & Co (100% owned)
businessLines.how: Hotel operating revenue plus reimbursed expenses (revenue composition not extracted from the sections read).
businessLines.description: A chain of 27 hotels: 11 owned by Loews Hotels, 15 owned by joint ventures with non-controlling interests (remaining one not described in the lines read).

revenue.note: Includes $127M of revenue related to reimbursable expenses; FY2024 $933M

businessLines.revenueNote: Includes $127M of revenue related to reimbursable expenses; FY2024 $933M

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $95M; net income attributable to Loews $31M (FY2024 $70M)

businessLines.name: Corporate (Loews parent)
businessLines.how: Net investment income on parent cash and securities less parent expenses, interest and the equity-method loss from Altium ($28M in 2025).
businessLines.description: Parent-company investment income and costs, plus the equity-method share of Altium Packaging (53%).

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $63M; net income attributable to Loews $19M

brands.name: Altium Packaging (53%, unconsolidated)
brands.note: Rigid plastic packaging; equity-method; not in segment revenue
